scripts.name: Collapsible dictionaries
scripts.description: Folds each dictionary in the popup to its name and the start of its first definition. Each word's first dictionary opens, and a dictionary you open or close stays that way until you reload the page.
scripts.author: bee-san

scripts.name: Coloured dictionary names
scripts.description: Gives each dictionary's name on its cards a colour of its own, the same on every word, so you can tell your dictionaries apart at a glance.
scripts.author: bee-san

scripts.name: Merge duplicate pitch accents
scripts.description: Lists a word's pitch accent once when several dictionaries give exactly the same patterns, with every one of those dictionaries' names on that line.
scripts.author: bee-san

scripts.name: Pitch accents in a row
scripts.description: Shows the pitch accent dictionaries side by side under the headword, wrapping onto the next line when the popup runs out of room, instead of one numbered line each.
scripts.author: bee-san

scripts.name: Texthooker
scripts.description: Turns the search page into a texthooker: the lines it keeps, newest at the bottom, with counts and times, a pause for the Clipboard monitor, and Edit and Delete on each line.
scripts.author: bee-san
